sources.label: 令和8年第2回定例会 審議結果

name: 保育士の配置基準の経過措置を変更
summary: 保育所の保育士配置基準には、基準改正に伴う経過措置があります。この議案で、3歳以上4歳未満の児童に関する経過措置の期限を2028年3月31日までとし、保育士の配置状況から保育の提供に支障が出るおそれがある場合は、4歳以上の児童に関する改正後の基準を適用しないこととします。
changes: 3歳以上4歳未満の児童に関する配置基準の経過措置を2028年3月31日までとする
保育の提供に支障が出るおそれがある場合、4歳以上の配置基準に改正前の基準を適用する
who: 保育所を利用する子ども
why: 児童福祉施設の設備及び運営に関する基準の一部改正に伴い、保育所の基準を改めるためと、県は説明しています。

en.name: Changes transitional measures for childcare worker staffing standards
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance Establishing Standards for the Facilities and Operation of Child Welfare Facilities
en.summary: Childcare centers have transitional measures for their childcare worker staffing standards following revisions to the standards. This bill sets March 31, 2028, as the deadline for the transitional measure concerning children aged 3 to under 4. It also provides that the revised standard for children aged 4 and over will not apply if staffing conditions could make it difficult to provide childcare.
changes: Set March 31, 2028, as the deadline for the transitional measure on staffing standards for children aged 3 to under 4
Apply the pre-amendment staffing standard for children aged 4 and over if staffing conditions could make it difficult to provide childcare
en.why: The prefecture says this is to revise childcare center standards following a partial revision of the standards for the facilities and operation of child welfare facilities.
